query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure remaining performance obligations RPO FY2026
normalized: cloud fy2026 infrastructure obligations oracle performance remaining rpo

output.content:
Oracle’s total remaining performance obligations (RPO)—the company-wide contracted backlog, not an OCI-only disclosed metric—ended FY2026 Q4 at **$638 billion**, up **363% year over year** and **$85 billion sequentially** from Q3. [[1]] 

During FY2026, reported total RPO rose from **$455 billion in Q1**, to **$523 billion in Q2**, **$553 billion in Q3**, and **$638 billion in Q4/FY-end**. [[2, 3, 4, 1]] 

Oracle did not report a separate OCI RPO balance in these releases; it said OCI demand was driving the backlog and, at Q1, forecast FY2026 OCI revenue of **$18 billion**, up **77%**. [[2]]
